data.body: RCA + fix pushed: live webhook 401s were not a stale-token mismatch after normalization; SSM, review-bot env, and refs/meta/config token hashes matched. A fresh smoke comment still produced webhooks-plugin 401s. Root cause: the deployed Gerrit 3.14 webhooks plugin ignores arbitrary 'header = X-Rebar-Token' config, so Gerrit never sent the token the hardened receiver required. RED coverage added: review-bot health exposes webhook auth rejections while liveness stays 200, Gerrit's internal X-Origin-Url path is accepted without unsupported header, public spoof via X-Forwarded-For is rejected, and observability publishes per-interval rejection deltas. Fix b52c9d440b27d pushed as Gerrit change 2928. Validation: targeted 179 passed; full 'make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2' passed with GIT_CONFIG_* unset.
